name: Na meji nevidnega
blurb: A Ljubljana convention for fantasy and science-fiction fans, with cosplay competitions, guests and programming across five halls.

editions.evidence: Homepage banner: 'NMN 2027 · 29. & 30. MAJ · PRODAJA VSTOPNIC SE ZAČNE JANUARJA 2027' (NMN 2027, May 29 & 30, ticket sales start January 2027)

notes: Corrected types from the given 'comics, scifi': the homepage describes it as a 'KONVENCIJA LJUBITELJEV FANTAZIJE IN ZNANSTVENE FANTASTIKE' (fantasy & sci-fi convention) with a dedicated Cosplay nav tab, cosplay competition and cosplay-guests pages, but no comics content found; used scifi+cosplay instead. The most recent completed edition (23-24 May 2026, Gospodarsko razstavišče/Ljubljana Exhibition and Convention Centre) already ended before the research window, so it is not listed; the next announced edition is 2027-05-29/30 but the site gives no venue for it yet (last year's venue not assumed) and ticket sales only start Jan 2027, so guests are not yet announced — the cosplay-gosti page still lists guests with no year marker, most likely tied to the passed May 2026 edition, so it was not used as a 2027 source. Organizer confirmed from footer: 'ORGANIZATOR DOGODKA KUD Šmaug'. Cover: no key art/banner image found (hero photos are crowd/booth photos of past editions), so the small square logo was used instead.
